static_traits.name: 林曼宁
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationships：偏好Being alone，缺乏亲密关系；社会支持系统较弱，但在需要时可向少数同事寻求帮助。
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy/咨询。
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe events and emotions concretely; highly cooperative, positive attitude; steady speech rate; has self-criticism and catastrophizing tendencies.

basic_info.main_problem: 我倾向于对自己的工作表现产生负面想法，尤其是在我犯错（如把订单弄错）时，这导致not足感和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: A recent event at work made me realize these negative thoughts are affecting my work performance and physical and mental health, so I sought counseling.
growth_experiences: 在一次繁忙班次中not小心将两位顾客的订单对调，其中一位顾客很生气并向经理投诉；自此在忙碌时段负面自动思维明显增多，常在尚not yet犯错前就预测会再出错，担心被解雇；负面思维影响睡眠与饮食，并加重Self-doubt。

special_situations.event: Gets a customer's order wrong during a busy shift; the customer complains to the manager
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯任何错误，就说明我not胜任工作，并会被他人negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Is harsher on themselves, repeatedly worries and self-criticizes, trying to avoid making mistakes again through greater tension and sustained vigilance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我把事情搞砸了，我永远也not会把工作做好

special_situations.event: 在繁忙时段尚not yet发生错误前就开始紧张与担忧
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我感到overwhelmed，就必然会犯错并引发严重后果
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前预演最坏情形、not断Self-monitoring以寻求控制
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一定又要出错了，后果会很糟糕

special_situations.event: 顾客表达not满或经理关注错误
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的态度和评价决定我的价值，他们not满就说明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifies self-blame and tension, excessive self-scrutiny to gain external recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定觉得我not行/经理在看not起我

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与被视为胜任
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被negate甚至被解雇
defense_goal: Avoids mistakes and criticism through self-reproach and high caution, maintaining a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: 容易犯错、需要not断纠正自己的服务员
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、会negate自己的顾客或经理

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及或回想工作中的错误、尤其是忙碌班次和他人not满反馈时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人会认为我not行，我的价值取决于他们的评价（移情：将外部not满视为对自身整体negate）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 在对话中先承认其自责感受，以温和、支持性的语气回应；use开放式Questioning与具体事实核查，避免Reinforcement自我攻击；引导其区分事件与自我价值。

manifestations: 偏好Being alone，缺乏亲密关系
A weaker social support system; only asks a few colleagues for help when needed
outcomes: In work-stress situations, lacks emotional buffering and support, so negative thinking cycles more easily
Increased anxiety并影响睡眠与饮食

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在叙述错误时频繁Self-denial（如“I am not good enough / incompetent”）
忙碌时过度谨慎与担忧、not断自我审查
Highly sensitive to potential criticism, treats others' attitudes as the basis of one's own value

exception_events.target_problem: 当工作中出现疏漏时，来访者通常会持续自责并担心再次犯错，导致在后续班次中更加Anxiety、表现受影响、睡眠被扰动。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 有一次忘记补充咖啡台后遭到顾客not满，她随后建立“定期检查咖啡台”的习惯，类似问题not yet再发生，并体验到信心提升。
exception_events.reason: not同做法：将错误视为改进线索并实施检查流程；任务拆解与提前准备让她获得可控感，从而减少灾难化与Anxiety。

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to try self-help strategies (deep breathing, positive self-talk, journaling)
Able to turn mistakes into improvement measures (building checking habits)
曾成功应对过忙碌班次的经验可供回忆与Reinforcement
在需要时可向同事寻求帮助
negative_force: 灾难化、跳结论、A cognitive pattern of overgeneralization and personalization
自我苛责与低自我价值感
压力高时对错误高度敏感，导致Sleep and diet affected

target_behavior.behavior: 工作情境中的灾难化担忧与Self-denial（如“I am not good enough/会被解雇”）
antecedent: 发生或回忆起订单错误
顾客表达not满或经理关注错误
target_behavior.core_reason: 一次订单错误事件后，将失误泛化为能力not足的核心信念，并对not yet来以灾难化方式进行预测（担心被解雇/永远做not好）。
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在失败与批评以获取控制感与安全感（通过过度担忧和Self-monitoring）。
target_behavior.consequence: Increased anxiety、Work performance affected、睡眠与饮食被扰动、Social withdrawal。
